text.text: *How to play:* each round one player DMs me a simple sentence about themselves. I turn it into corporate jargon and DM it to everyone else, who have 60 seconds to guess the original. An AI judge scores each guess 0–100 on meaning: the top three get *10 / 5 / 1* points. If nobody gets close, the writer earns *+10*.

`/jargonator start`: Start a game in this channel
`/jargonator join`: Join the game here (any time)
`/jargonator leave`: Leave the game (your score is kept)
`/jargonator status`: Show the game's state and scores
`/jargonator next`: Host: start the next round
`/jargonator kick @someone`: Host: remove a player
`/jargonator end`: Host or admin: end the game
`/jargonator help`: Show this help
